title: Envelope
description: Every WebSocket frame is one UTF-8 JSON text message with this shape. Receivers validate the envelope first, then the payload for the given type.

MessageTypeName.title: MessageTypeName
MessageTypeName.description: Dotted lower camel case, e.g. slot.request.

MessageId.title: MessageId
MessageId.description: Chosen by the sender of a request, echoed unchanged in the reply.
